lee: Heads-up: scheduling an emergency rollback drill + SLO-flex exercise Wednesday 2025-06-11 02:30->03:15 UTC. Focus: validate our rollback choreography, SLO emergency-flex window, and cross-team paging behavior.

lee: Scope: runtime-scheduler, model-proxy, routing-service, and the dedicated-fallback policy. This is a simulation against prod-sim endpoints (no real customer traffic). Expect transient 5xx during the drill if the rollback path is exercised.

taylor: Plan outline: 1) trigger synthetic degradation, 2) invoke automated rollback to known-good revision, 3) enable SLO emergency-flex (+1s on 99.9p) for 20m, 4) validate rollback success and metrics reconciliation.

jamal: Can we confirm the abort/runstop command and who holds the kill switch?

lee: Abort command is in the runbook; runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-drill-20250611. Kill switch held by oncall + platform-eng. One-liner to stop generators and revert policies:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/drills/stop -H \"Authorization: Bearer $DRILL_KEY\"
```

erin: Request: start with a tiny canary (2 tenants) for 10m, then proceed to wide exercise if no issues. Also, I'll watch auth errors and KV cache miss rate; abort if kv miss > 35% for 3m.

alesha: Who signs the SLO emergency-flex? Product Ops and SRE lead? We need an audit entry for later.

lee: Yes — Product Ops (alesha) + SRE lead (lee) must sign-off in the runbook UI before the drill starts. All approvals will be recorded automatically.

taylor: Implementation notes: autoscaler will be pinned to desired during the drill for deterministic capacity. Rollback uses immutable deploy tags and switches route-weights; no DB migrations involved. Cache prefill job will run 8m before each tenant group shift.

ops-bot: Drill scheduled: id=drill-20250611-rollback. Notifications sent to #eng-oncall, #platform, #product-ops 48h prior. :rotating_light:

jamal: I'll prepare an incident stub and dashboards: rollback-success-rate, route-fallback-rate, kv-cache-hit, auth-error-rate, and SLO-burn. If rollback doesn't reach success criteria in 5m, we escalate to exec-runbook.

erin: I'll add a synthetic E2E test that verifies model-call success after rollback completes; will page if test fails twice in a row.

alesha: I'll notify CS for the canary tenant list and make sure no enterprise-SLA tenants are included. Also prepping a short internal email template in case we need to notify wider org.

lee: TL;DR: rollback drill + SLO-flex window Wednesday 2025-06-11 02:30-03:15 UTC, canary first, abort cmd + runbook linked, approvals required from Product Ops + SRE lead. Ack please by EOD 2025-06-09. :white_check_mark:
